record.question:
With the abolition of the Planning Commission, the structural framework of Planning and
    Developmental Administration transitioned to NITI Aayog. Consider the following structural
    differences and select the correct answers:
      1. The Planning Commission followed a strict top-down model of development planning, whereas
          NITI Aayog emphasizes a bottom-up approach rooted in cooperative federalism.
      2. NITI Aayog possesses the statutory power to allocate financial resources and plan outlays to
          central ministries and state governments.
      3. The Governing Council of NITI Aayog includes the Chief Ministers of all States and Lieutenant
          Governors of Union Territories.
